title: Corrected disposition of the Top 20 entries in ROGER_SOURCE_UNBLOCK_LIST.md
required_generator_invariants: Reject an issuing-court-or-agency value containing a plus-joined list of form IDs.
Reject an official URL containing corpus metadata, a private/source-imports path, a SHA token, CSV fields, or more than one URL-shaped value.
Do not emit ASK_CLERK when a public official source page or artifact URL is already known.
Do not create separate acquisition obligations for pages, sections, attachments, or forms embedded in a canonical bundle.
Represent aliases and component locators explicitly.

Separate missing_source_binary, missing_canonical_relationship_metadata, currentness_unverified, family_identity_ambiguous, unsupported_relationship, statutory_custom_pleading, and license_permission_review.
Require a verified target and a specific unresolved question before a human-contact task may be emitted.
Rank by unique canonical artifact and unique family, not by repeated family references across rows.
Route custom pleadings/statutory citations to packet-build/legal work, never to source acquisition.
Route copyright or redistribution restrictions to counsel/business, not to a clerk.
